title: Snowy Hub | Auto Farm, Troll, Speed, Anti AFK, Fling & More
features:
Auto Farm All Money – Automatically collects money across the map.

Auto Farm Lobby Money – Automatically collects money from the Lobby.

Auto Farm VIP Money – Automatically collects money from the VIP area.

Teleport Delay – Adjusts the delay between money collection teleports.

WalkSpeed – Controls your movement speed.

Anti-AFK – Helps prevent the game from removing you for inactivity.

Server Hop – Automatically switches to another public server.

Funny Emotes – Provides a collection of fun character animations.

Spinbot – Makes your character continuously spin.

Floor Crawl – Makes your character crawl along the floor.

Bunny Hop – Automatically jumps when touching the ground.

Crazy Flail – Creates a chaotic flailing character animation.

Yeet Yourself – Launches your character into the air.

Jelly Body – Makes your character's body parts pulsate.

Spaghetti Limbs – Stretches your character's limbs in a rhythmic motion.

RGB Flashing Body – Cycles your character through rainbow colors.

Walk Upside Down – Rotates your character upside down.

Troll Target – Selects a player as the troll target.

Target Nearest Player – Automatically targets the closest player.

Behind Back Troll – Teleports behind the selected target.

Orbit Troll – Orbits around the selected target.

Fling Troll – Attempts to fling the selected target.

Troll Customization – Adjusts troll speed and distance.

World Effects – Applies different lighting, sky, and atmosphere effects.

Extra Fun Effects – Adds various visual and character effects.

Moon Gravity – Lowers the game's gravity.

Trampoline Jump – Increases jump power.

Helicopter Mode – Spins and lifts your character while holding Space.

Stare at Nearest – Keeps your character facing the closest player.

Action Toggles – Provides quick actions for sitting and relaxing animations.

FPS Boost – Optimizes rendering settings to improve performance.

Revert FPS Changes – Restores the original rendering and lighting settings.

UI Customization – Adjusts DPI scaling, notifications, and cursor settings.

Keybinds – Configures the menu toggle key and displays active keybinds.

Unload – Completely removes the hub and its interface.
